answer_1.quote: ...In the final stage, we generate medically accurate and context-aware responses using reranked documents...

answer_2.quote: ...We evaluated our model using semantic and quantitative metrics to assess the accuracy and contextual appropriateness of generated responses. For semantic evaluation, we adopted BERTScore... We also employed lexical metrics including ROUGE-2, BLEU-4, and METEOR... To address the limitations of traditional metrics... we adopt MinosEval... using Top-1 Hit Rate and Avg NLI Score...

answer_3.quote: ...These evaluations were conducted using the OpenAI o1 model... The prompts used for this assessment are provided in Appendix D... We designed three structured prompts targeting hallucination detection, grammatical correctness, and patient helpfulness...
